packageRules.description: Default: batch non-major Go module updates into a single PR. Majors stay individual (separateMajorMinor) because they routinely need import-path changes. Rules below override this for families that must move on their own.
Default: batch non-major Actions updates into a single PR, kept separate from gomod so an unrelated failure does not block both

k8s libs and the Helm SDK are version-locked to argo-cd v3.4: k8s 0.34.x and its partner helm 3.19.x (helm 3.N pairs with k8s 0.(N+15)). Do NOT approve past those minors until argo-cd moves its own k8s minor — 0.35+ removes API packages (autoscaling/v2beta1, autoscaling/v2beta2, scheduling/v1alpha1) that argo-cd's k8s.io/kubernetes internals still import; verified locally that 0.36.3 + helm 3.21.3 does not build. Held behind the dashboard rather than capped with allowedVersions so newer releases stay visible instead of being filtered out of lookup.
Publishes its staging deps as v0.0.0; bot PRs are unresolvable without replace directives

The argo-cd client must track the deployed server (chart pin in internal/infraconfig/defaults/argocd.yaml), so every bump is a hand-held change: move the chart together with it, repoint the go.mod gitops-engine replace at the new release tag commit, and re-check the kubernetes group above if argo-cd's k8s minor moved. Majors additionally rewrite import paths across 6 files.
Replace-pinned in go.mod to the argo-cd release tag commit; must never move independently of github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v3
docker/docker is +incompatible; crossing to v28 needs import changes

Held: argo-cd v3.4 caps go-git at v5.14.0 upstream ("DO NOT BUMP UNTIL go-git/go-git#1551 is fixed" in its go.mod), so moving ahead of that puts us off the version argo-cd is tested against. The older filepath-securejoin conflict is gone — the v3 migration selects go-git 5.14.0 / go-billy 5.6.2 / securejoin 0.6.1 together. Needs its own group so it cannot red the non-major batch; revisit when upstream lifts its cap.

Held: k3d v5.9 requires Go >=1.26.3 (module targets 1.26.0) and forces docker/docker v28, which the rule above disables. A minor bump that is really a toolchain change. Needs its own group so it cannot red the non-major batch.
bubbletea/bubbles/lipgloss must never diverge across majors
Tree is already internally skewed (otel 1.40.0 vs otelgrpc 0.56.0); bump together
Pseudo-version deps churn on every upstream commit; batch them monthly. Needs its own group so the monthly schedule does not conflict with the weekly non-major group above.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
